plans.title: Agente Acid (AI web starter)
features: Agente Acid embedded on your website

sections.title: Highlights
items: Customizable Agente Acid for your website
FAQs adjusted to your brand tone
Lead qualification: the bot asks for name, contact, budget, and intent
Smart redirects to WhatsApp or key pages

sections.title: How lead qualification works
sections.body: Agente Acid asks conversational questions and stores the data as a prospect:
items: Captures name, phone/email, need, budget, and urgency
Immediate notification to your team by email or WhatsApp
Dashboard record with conversation history
CSV export for your CRM or sales team
Monthly usage limits: 1M input tokens + 1M output tokens

sections.title: Available flow templates
sections.body: Choose one when hiring and we tune it to your operation:
items: Qualify leads: contact details, budget, and priority
Basic quote: scope, integrations, and project urgency
Pre-sales support: inquiry reason, product of interest, and contact

sections.title: Includes
items: Agente Acid installation (snippet + guide)
1 preconfigured flow to choose from
Basic FAQ and tone adjustment
Dashboard with conversations, leads, history, and bot pause
Email notifications for your team

sections.title: Agente Acid integrations available
items: Embeddable AI agent with quick chips, WhatsApp CTA, and lead capture
Google Calendar for appointment creation, availability checks, duration, and timezone
Email for lead alerts, forms, and password recovery
Redirects to WhatsApp or key URLs without requiring the conversational add-on

sections.title: Deliverables
items: Snippet to insert on your site
Dashboard with captured leads and CSV export
Email and WhatsApp notifications

sections.title: Requirements
items: Website where Agente Acid can be embedded
Base FAQs and legal/policy messages

plans.title: WhatsApp Add-on (conversational channel)
features: 200 messages/month included within the WhatsApp service window
Qualified leads and purchase links through WhatsApp
Detects purchase intent and guides customers toward closing the sale

sections.title: Highlights
items: Serves customers directly on WhatsApp with AI
Answers questions, qualifies leads, and shares purchase links
Detects purchase intent and guides customers toward closing the sale

sections.title: Price and messages
sections.body: The plan includes 200 messages within the WhatsApp service window.
items: $500 MXN/month (+VAT) — 200 messages included
Additional message add-on: +$500 MXN/month for 500 extra messages
With the extra add-on, the total increases to 700 messages per month
WhatsApp number rental: $6.25 USD/month paid by the client (charged by Twilio/Meta, not included in this plan)

sections.title: Includes
items: WhatsApp channel setup to receive and answer messages
Automatic AI replies adapted to the business
Flows to answer questions, capture customer data, and move sales opportunities forward
Purchase or payment links based on the active integration: Shopify, Mercado Libre, WooCommerce, or Stripe

sections.title: WhatsApp functions
items: Conversational WhatsApp support with business context
Lead capture and qualification from incoming messages
Purchase-intent follow-up and closing with purchase links
Order notifications to the business or customer when applicable

sections.title: Deliverables
items: Enabled number or access method
Operational flow and testing checklist

sections.title: Additional client costs
items: Twilio number rental: about $6.25 USD/month (billed directly by Twilio)
Messages outside the plan: $500 MXN/month for 500 additional messages
Preapproved proactive templates by Meta (if applicable)

sections.title: Requirements
items: WhatsApp number available to activate or connect
Twilio number rental when using a Twilio-managed number
Catalog, store, or payment provider configured when purchase links are needed
